# Design point P018

## Description

Clients use a compressed Git index to reduce local repository metadata while performing normal working-tree operations. Pushes may target any healthy repository primary without leader election; durable compare-and-swap synchronization coordinates concurrent updates, while the client-side index optimization remains independent of server write-consistency policy.
